metaDescription: Lelen tomato is a tomato variety for Luzon. About 66 days to harvest. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Lelen is a registered tomato variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2023 as NSIC 2023 Tm 21. It takes about 66 days from transplanting to the first harvest.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Lelen tomato takes about 66 days from transplanting to the first harvest. That is 4.9 days faster than the average of the 20 tomato varieties with a day count, 70.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt).

The pests and diseases that hit tomato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [late blight](/diseases/late-blight), [tomato leaf curl](/diseases/tomato-leaf-curl), [whitefly](/pests/whitefly), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A fruit weighs about 38.13 grams. It grew about 4.21 cm long. It is round.
Where and when to plant Lelen tomato

It is recommended for Luzon in the dry season. Bacterial wilt kills more lowland tomato than any other disease, so in the wet season pick a variety rated resistant to it. Choose a firm, oblong fruit if you sell to a far market, and a round, juicy one for fresh sale nearby. Heat tolerant hybrids set fruit in the hot months, when open pollinated tomatoes often drop their flowers. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).
